description: An endless runner where Blaze sprints automatically and you tap to jump over lava gaps. Speed increases as your distance grows — how far can you run?
fireSafetyLesson: If fire blocks your path, never try to jump over it — get LOW, get OUT, and call 911!
title: Blaze Runner

description: A vertical platform jumper — bounce Ember ever higher by landing on platforms. Steer with drag, arrow keys, or device tilt. Don't fall!
fireSafetyLesson: Climb UP to safety! In a fire, never use elevators — take the stairs to fresh air.
title: Ember Jump

description: Move the basket left and right to catch falling embers for points. Dodge the falling rocks — each one costs a heart. Three hearts, catch 'em all!
fireSafetyLesson: Firefighters save what they can and steer clear of danger — catch the good, dodge the bad!
title: Cinder Catch

description: Rocks rain from the sky — slide Spark left and right to dodge them all. The longer you survive, the faster they fall. Pure reflex survival!
fireSafetyLesson: In an emergency, stay alert and move to safety — never freeze, keep moving!
title: Spark Dodge

description: Guide a Fire Baby through a lava-walled maze to reach the cool water pool. Use the on-screen arrows, swipe, or keyboard. Beat your best escape time!
fireSafetyLesson: Know TWO ways out of every room! Practice your family's fire escape plan.
title: Flame Maze

description: A memory match card game with 8 pairs of cute Fire Baby faces — each with unique colors and expressions. Flip two cards, find all the matches!
fireSafetyLesson: Matches and lighters are TOOLS, not toys — only grown-ups should use them!
title: Fire Baby Memory

description: Press and hold to charge your jump, release to leap across rock platforms over bubbling lava. Judge the power just right — too short or too far and it's splashdown!
fireSafetyLesson: Hot surfaces burn! Never touch stoves, ovens, or grills without a grown-up.
title: Lava Leap

description: Colored embers rain down — tap a falling ember, then tap its matching color bin (orange, blue, or green). Wrong bin or dropped ember costs a heart!
fireSafetyLesson: Keep flammable things AWAY from heat — paper, curtains and clothes need space from anything hot!
title: Ember Sort

description: Classic breakout with a Fire Babys twist — bounce the fireball with your paddle to smash crystal blocks. Some blocks take two hits. Clear them all to win!
fireSafetyLesson: Fire needs heat + fuel + oxygen. Remove ANY one and the fire goes OUT!
title: Blaze Breaker

description: A 3x3 slide puzzle featuring a cute Fire Baby picture. Tap tiles next to the empty space to slide them and rebuild the image in as few moves as possible!
fireSafetyLesson: Piece it together! Everyone in your family should know the fire escape plan by heart.
title: Sizzle Slide

description: Campfire targets keep popping up — tap each one to blast it with your water hose! Put out as many fires as you can in 60 seconds. (Our Fire Baby friends are safe!)
fireSafetyLesson: Water beats fire! But leave BIG fires to firefighters — get OUT and call 911!
title: Fire Hose Hero
